default.description: Every CS Viewer v2 window: the main graph window, every per-document window it spawns (`doc-1`, `doc-2`, …) and every detached pane (`pane-side`, `pane-source`, `pane-nodeDrawer`, `pane-findPanel`). All of them may call the IPC commands the UI uses — `api` (the whole /api/* surface, answered by the Rust engine), `open_doc_window`, `open_pane_window` (spawn or focus a detached pane) and `close_pane_window` (redock one) — and listen for the `cs:*` events that keep the windows in step.
